reviewOfflineSales.needsConnection: This action needs a connection to the server. Try again when the connection is back.
reviewOfflineSales.approvalWrongAction: The manager's approval is not for this action.
reviewOfflineSales.reasonTooShort: Enter a reason of at least 10 characters.
reviewOfflineSales.notFound: This offline sale was not found on this terminal.
reviewOfflineSales.notAwaitingReview: This sale is no longer waiting for review.
reviewOfflineSales.notQueued: Only a sale that is still queued can be sent to review.
reviewOfflineSales.secondaryInstance: This app is open in another window, which handles offline sales. Resolve them there.
reviewOfflineSales.ownSale: This sale belongs to the signed-in person and will be sent to the server automatically.
reviewOfflineSales.serverMismatch: The server holds a sale that does not match this one. It cannot be re-rung or moved to review: it can only be written off.
reviewOfflineSales.alreadyWrittenOff: The server already wrote this sale off. It cannot be re-rung; use Write off to close it here.
reviewOfflineSales.reRingWrittenOff: This sale was written off on the server. Clear the re-ring cart, then use Write off to close the record.
reviewOfflineSales.reRingNotApproved: The server has no approved re-ring for this sale, or the re-ring was rung by a different user than the one who received the approval. Clear the cart and ask for a new approval from this till.
reviewOfflineSales.reRingAlreadyClosed: This sale is already closed on the server. Clear the re-ring cart.
reviewOfflineSales.reRingPaidOnServer: A re-ring for this sale is already paid. Clear the cart; use Write off to close the record.
reviewOfflineSales.reRingAlreadyPaid: The server holds a paid re-ring for this sale that is already linked to another offline sale. This record cannot be closed here; report it to the administrator.
reviewOfflineSales.serverCheckFailed: Could not check on the server whether the sale is already recorded. Nothing was changed on this till; try again.
reviewOfflineSales.serverOutcomeUnknown: The server did not confirm the result, so the sale may already have been handled. Use Write off: the server answers the same way if it is repeated.
reviewOfflineSales.notStored: The change could not be saved on this terminal. Try again.
reviewOfflineSales.notConfirmed: This sale has no receipt confirmed by the server.
reviewOfflineSales.printUnavailable: The receipt copy of this sale was cleared to make room on this terminal. Reprint it from Payments.
reviewOfflineSales.approvalSpent: This approval was already used. Ask a manager for a new approval.
reviewOfflineSales.serverUpdateRequired: This terminal needs the server to be updated before it can do this. Nothing was changed; the sale stays in review.
reviewOfflineSales.approvalRejected: The server did not accept the manager's approval. Ask a manager for a new approval. Nothing was changed.
reviewOfflineSales.busy: Another action on this sale is still in progress. Wait for it to finish.
reviewOfflineSales.reRingCartNotEmpty: The cart is not empty. Finish or clear the current sale before re-ringing this one.
reviewOfflineSales.reRingProductsMissing: These items can no longer be sold as they were: {{items}}. Write the sale off instead.
reviewOfflineSales.reRingLicenseRestricted: The licence is restricted, so a new sale cannot be rung and the approval would be wasted. Write the sale off, or re-ring it once the licence is restored.
reviewOfflineSales.reRingCatalogNotLoaded: Today's products and prices have not loaded yet. Check the connection and try again.
reviewOfflineSales.reRingNoTotal: This sale has no recorded total, so it cannot be re-rung. Write it off instead.
reviewOfflineSales.reRingUntrusted: This sale's stored data does not match its checksum, so the server cannot be checked for it. It cannot be re-rung; write it off instead.
reviewOfflineSales.reRingInProgress: This sale is being re-rung in the cart. Finish that sale or clear the cart first.
reviewOfflineSales.reRingCartChanged: This cart no longer matches the sale being re-rung. Put back the original items, or clear the cart and ring the new sale on its own.
reviewOfflineSales.reRingAlreadyCompleted: This re-ring was already completed and its sale is already recorded. Clear the cart without ringing the goods again.
reviewOfflineSales.retryNotSeller: Only the cashier who rang this sale can retry it, from their own session. Re-ring or write it off instead.
reviewOfflineSales.retryAfterLostWriteOff: The answer to the write-off was lost, so the server may already have written this sale off. Use Write off to confirm; do not retry.
reviewOfflineSales.reRingAfterLostWriteOff: The answer to the write-off was lost, so the server may already have written this sale off. Only Write off can settle it; do not ring it again.
reviewOfflineSales.retryAfterReRing: A re-ring of this sale was already tried and may be paid, so it cannot be sent again. Use Re-ring or Write off: both check the server first.
reviewOfflineSales.reRingNotLinked: The sale was rung up as {{tab}}, but the offline record could not be closed. Do not re-ring it again. Ask a manager to check it.

dialog.title: Offline sales
dialog.description: Sales rung while the connection to the server was down. Queued sales are sent automatically; a sale the server refused waits here for a manager.
dialog.empty: No offline sales on this terminal.
dialog.managerHint: Actions marked (manager) ask a manager for their PIN.
dialog.waitingOwn: Waiting to send. It is sent automatically.
dialog.heldOwn: This sale could not be confirmed after repeated attempts. If it stays like this, a manager can move it to review.
dialog.overpaid: The customer paid {{amount}} more than today's price.
dialog.shortfall: The server holds {{amount}} less than the offline sale.
dialog.duplicateRering: This sale reached the server twice: the original and its re-ring. The record is closed with the original. Refund the re-ring sale ({{number}}) on Payments.

reason.AMOUNT_MISMATCH: The total changed while the connection was down (a price or a promotion moved). Re-ring the sale at today's prices.
reason.PRICE_MISMATCH: A product's price changed while the connection was down. Re-ring the sale at today's prices.
reason.BELOW_COST_REQUIRES_OVERRIDE: At today's cost this sale falls below cost and needs a manager's override. Re-ring it with a manager.
reason.INVENTORY_NEGATIVE: The server did not have enough stock for this sale. Adjust the stock, then retry.
reason.CAJA_CLOSED: The cash register was closed on the server. Write the sale off after recording it by hand, or re-ring it into the open register.
reason.SHIFT_NOT_OPEN: The cashier's shift was closed on the server. A manager can write the sale off with their PIN; the goods are then sold again from a session with an open shift.
reason.FORBIDDEN: The cashier is no longer allowed to sell. A manager can write the sale off with their PIN; the goods are then sold again from a session that is allowed to sell.
reason.IDEMPOTENCY_UNAUTHORIZED: This sale was sent by someone other than the cashier who rang it. Sign in as that cashier, or write it off with a reason.
reason.INVALID_ITEMS: The server could not accept the items on this sale. Write it off with a reason.
reason.WEIGHT_OUT_OF_RANGE: A weighed item had a weight the server could not accept. Write the sale off with a reason.
reason.ZERO_TOTAL_SALE: This sale totalled 0.00 and the server refused it. Write it off with a reason.
reason.MODIFIER_MISMATCH: An option on an item no longer matches its product. Write the sale off with a reason.
reason.INVALID_METHOD: The server could not accept this payment method. Write the sale off with a reason.
reason.UNKNOWN: The server did not accept this sale and did not say why. Retry, or ask a manager to re-ring or write it off.
reason.TAMPERED: The stored sale does not match its checksum, so it was not sent. Ask a manager to check it; it can only be written off.
reason.ESCALATED: A manager moved this sale to review because its cashier was not signed in. Sign in as that cashier, or write it off.

notices.writtenOff: Sale written off. The cash and the stock are for the manager to put right by hand.
notices.alreadyRecorded: Good news: the server already has this sale (receipt {{number}}). Nothing was written off or re-rung.
notices.alreadyReRung: Good news: this sale was already re-rung and paid (receipt {{number}}). It is now linked to that sale. Nothing was written off or rung again.

dialog.failed: That did not work. Nothing was changed.
dialog.askManagerStock: Ask a manager to correct the stock for this item from Inventory on another device, then tap Retry here. If that is not possible, a manager can write the sale off with their PIN.

reviewOfflineSales.printFailed: The receipt could not be printed. Check the printer and try again.

reason.method: Not available offline. Take cash or card, or wait until the connection is back.
reason.split_method: A split payment offline can only be cash and card.
reason.card_reference_missing: Enter the approval reference from the card terminal to sell offline.
reason.discount: Discounts need a connection. Remove the discount or wait until the connection is back.
reason.override: A manager override needs a connection.
reason.license: This terminal's license doesn't allow selling offline right now.
reason.revalidation: This terminal has been offline too long, or its saved prices are out of date. Reconnect so it can be verified before selling.
reason.no_open_caja: Selling offline needs the register and your shift already open. Open them while online.
reason.limit: This terminal can't store more offline sales. Reconnect so the stored sales can be sent.
reason.limit_count: {{count}} offline sales are waiting on this terminal, the most it can hold. Reconnect so they can be sent before selling more.
reason.limit_age: The oldest offline sale on this terminal is {{hours}} hours old or more. Reconnect so the stored sales can be sent before selling more.
reason.rering: A re-ring has to be completed online. Reconnect to finish it.
reason.secondary_instance: This app is open in another window, which handles offline sales. Sell offline from that window, or close this one.
